# HTSH.PL

> Personal site of Krzysztof Lewczuk, a DevOps engineer working across CI/CD, cloud and on-prem infrastructure, and self-hosting.

## Main

- [About](https://htsh.pl/about/): Background, current role, and interests
- [Contact](https://htsh.pl/contact/): Email, LinkedIn, GitHub
- [CV](https://htsh.pl/cv/): Full resume

## Content

- [Blog](https://htsh.pl/blog/): Posts on DevOps, self-hosting, and homelab projects
- [Projects](https://htsh.pl/projects/): Personal software projects
- [Tidbits](https://htsh.pl/tidbits/): Smaller notes, observations, and research (e.g. local LLM benchmarks)
- [Links](https://htsh.pl/links/): Curated external links, categorized
